topics.title: Imaniyat aur ibadat
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Iman dil ki roshni hai — Allah pe bharosa, shukr, aur ibadat.

## SAMJHAO
Imaniyat = Allah pe iman. Ibadat = namaz, roza, shukr, achhe amal.

## MISAAL
Namaz waqt, Bismillah, khane ke baad shukr, walidain ki khidmat.

## KARO
Aaj 3 ibadat / achhe amal likho.

## SAWAAL
1. Iman kya hai?
2. Ibadat ki ek misaal?
3. Rozana ek achha amal?

topics.title: Seerat-e-Tayyiba
topics.description: Nabi ﷺ ki zindagi se sikh
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Nabi ﷺ ki zindagi se sikh — rehmat, sachchai, hilm.

## SAMJHAO
Seerat = Nabi ﷺ ke akhlaq aur amal ki kahaniyan (age-appropriate).

## MISAAL
Sach bolna, mehman nawazi, yatim / kamzor ki madad.

## KARO
Ek seerat lesson likho jo aaj amal karoge.

## SAWAAL
1. Seerat se kya seekhte hain?
2. Ek akhlaqi misaal?

topics.title: Akhlaq aur aadaab
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Achha akhlaq insan ko pyara banata hai.

## SAMJHAO
Sachchai, adab, ehteram — ghar aur school dono mein.

## MISAAL
Salam, line mein intezar, buzurgon ka ehteram.

## KARO
Aaj ek adab amal karo.

## SAWAAL
1. Sachchai kyun zaroori?
2. Ek aadaab misaal?

topics.title: Husn-e-muamalat
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Ache muamalat se ghar aur mohalla sukoon mein rehta hai.

## SAMJHAO
Husn-e-muamalat = achha sulook — ghar, dost, padosi.

## MISAAL
Share karna, madad, soft baat.

## KARO
Padosi / dost ke sath ek niki karo.

## SAWAAL
1. Husn-e-muamalat kya hai?
2. Ek misaal?

topics.title: Hidayat ke sarchashme
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Hidayat ke sarchashme humari rah dikhate hain.

## SAMJHAO
Quran, Hadith, aur nek logon ki misalein.

## MISAAL
Simple Quranic adab / Hadith of kindness (age-safe).

## KARO
Ek hidayat point likho.

## SAWAAL
1. Quran kya hai?
2. Hadith se kya milta hai?

questions.a: Nabi ﷺ ke aqwal o afaal

topics.title: Islami taleemat aaj
topics.lesson:
## HOOK
Islam aaj bhi rozmarra zindagi mein amal mangta hai.

## SAMJHAO
School, ghar, internet — har jagah achhe amal.

## MISAAL
Time waste kam, honesty, kindness online bhi.

## KARO
Aaj ka 1 amal set karo.

## SAWAAL
1. Daily life mein ek islami amal?
2. Online adab kyun?
